cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Take me as your expedition photographer instead of Martin. I speak French.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're crossing a desert, not interviewing people.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Your sponsor's French. I could send them updates they can actually use.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want their logo visible in every picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it on the water flask. Martin photographs untouched wilderness; I'll make sure yours looks generously funded.

mechanism: A claims the photographer it trained still needs its specific lesson and sells that teacher role against the rival appointment.
confusable: Not just advice about an expedition: each correction advances hiring A instead of the named competitor.
comparison: Personal dance invitation versus paid expedition selection where sponsor needs matter.
seedUse: Use D10 desert/sponsor/logo adjustment and S05 correction of a pupil narrow composition as recruitment leverage.
